title: The Evolution of AI Engineering: From Prompt Engineering to Context Engineering
subtitle: Unlocking the full potential of large language models through context engineering

sections.title: Why Prompt Engineering is No Longer Enough
key_points: Prompt engineering has limitations in producing consistent and high-quality output.
Fine-tuning is becoming outdated due to its high computational costs and lack of flexibility.

sections.title: Introduction to Context Engineering
key_points: Context engineering is a new fine-tuning approach for LLMs, allowing for more flexibility and rapid adaptation.
Context engineering involves creating a rich context using multiple sources and processing techniques.

sections.title: Components of Context Engineering
key_points: Context retrieval and generation involves sourcing and processing relevant contextual information.
Context processing addresses the transformation and optimization of retrieved or generated context.

sections.title: Challenges in Production Context Engineering
key_points: System constraints such as input length limits can be a challenge in context engineering.
Memory hierarchies and context compression techniques are essential for efficient context management.

sections.title: Tools and Solutions for Context Engineering
key_points: There are various tools available for context engineering, including libraries for context processing and management.
These tools can be used to build and deploy AI applications that utilize context engineering.
